status_note: Day complete (Sunday). Fat-heavy eating-out day (~2,475 kcal, ~164 g protein, ~67 g carb, ~158 g fat, ~14 g fiber) — hollandaise/béarnaise/garlic-butter/carpaccio stacked fat to ~2.4× target. But two things went right: the deliberate lean-chicken-breast + green-beans dinner landed protein essentially ON target (164/165) without piling fat, and a big 13.35 km / 17.1K-step walking day (~529 active kcal) offset a large chunk of the calories. Full supplement stack in; all sperm-priority micros met. One watch-item: this was the 4th alcohol day of the week (0.5 glass wine) — small but frequent; a run of dry days would help the weekly alcohol factor.
